newsitem.title: CYPRUS: CYPRUS JULY CPI RISES 1.16 PCT MONTH/MONTH.
newsitem.headline: CYPRUS JULY CPI RISES 1.16 PCT MONTH/MONTH.

text.p: Cyprus's consumer price index increased by 1.16 percent month-on-month in July to 120.95 from 119.56 in June, the department of statistics and research said.
The index (base 1992) was 116.36 in July 1996, giving a year-on-year rise in July 1997 of 3.94 percent.
The department said the monthly rise was mainly due to the increase in the price of fresh fruit, beverages and tobacco. Prices of clothing and footwear decreased in the month.
